responsibility: Implements GCC’s AddressSanitizer and Hardware-assisted AddressSanitizer instrumentation on GIMPLE and related lowering support, turning internal ASAN/HWASAN checks into concrete shadow-memory tests or runtime builtin calls, poisoning and unpoisoning stack/global regions, and emitting module constructors that initialize the sanitizer runtime. The file owns the compiler-side logic for selecting access-check forms, laying out and describing ASan-protected stack frames and redzones, handling HWASan tag generation and stack tagging, and expanding sanitizer internal functions such as ASAN_CHECK, ASAN_MARK, ASAN_POISON, HWASAN_CHECK, and HWASAN_MARK into the runtime ABI declared in asan.h.
same_name_distinction: Implementation companion to gcc/asan.h: this source file contains the executable ASan/HWASan instrumentation and file-finalization logic, including expansion of ASAN/HWASAN internal functions, stack/global poisoning, shadow/tag handling, and constructor emission. Unlike the header, it does not define the shared declarations, constants, ABI macros, or inline policy helpers used by other sanitizer code.
